step_by_step_reasoning: The whiteboard diagram illustrates a monolith database decomposition into specialized AWS data storage and management services. At the top, a container representing the legacy Monolith Data (divided into Binary, Relational, Key/Value, and Encrypted types) connects to four target AWS services: Amazon S3 (for binary/blob data), Amazon Aurora Serverless (for relational data), Amazon DynamoDB (for key/value data), and AWS Secrets Manager (for encrypted sensitive data). Below, individual microservices (Service A and Service B) connect directly to their respective storage instances (Service A to S3; Service B to S3 and Aurora). At the bottom center, AWS KMS connects to all storage/security services (S3, Aurora, DynamoDB, Secrets Manager) to manage multi-tenant encryption keys.
